europe_now.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with deadly Russian strikes on civilian targets
europe_now.summary: Russian forces have launched a new wave of attacks on Ukrainian civilian infrastructure, killing dozens and raising fears of a broader escalation. European leaders have condemned the strikes and pledged additional military aid, including air-defense systems.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Zelensky asks for more Patriot interceptors as civilian deaths hit highest level since 2022

europe_now.title: Forest fires and flash floods impact multiple European regions
europe_now.summary: Severe wildfires in France and Spain have forced evacuations and claimed lives, while flash floods in Spain have compounded the damage. Authorities have linked the extreme weather events to rising temperatures and climate change.

top_stories.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with deadly Russian strikes on civilian targets
top_stories.summary: Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities have killed civilians and destroyed critical infrastructure, prompting urgent appeals for more Western military support. European nations are responding with increased defense aid and sanctions against Moscow.

top_stories.title: Forest fires and flash floods impact multiple European regions
top_stories.summary: Wildfires across France and Spain have displaced thousands and killed several people, while flash floods in Spain have caused further destruction. Officials attribute the disasters to extreme heat and changing climate patterns.
